name: facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craftassist/voxel_models/semantic_segmentation/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.create_semseg_dataset: create a SemSegData dataset from a pickle file with configurable sidelength and augmentation options
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.flip_rotate_voxel_cube: randomly rotate or flip a 3D voxel cube tensor and its labels for data augmentation
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.fit_schematic_in_sidelength: crop and pad a 3D voxel schematic to fit a fixed sidelength cube with random shifts
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.organize_semantic_classes: merge rare and plural semantic classes below a minimum occurrence threshold into a unified class map
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.pad_schematic_to_sidelength: pad a 3D voxel schematic tensor to a target sidelength using PyTorch functional padding

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.build_semsegnet: build a 3D convolutional semantic segmentation network for voxel block classification using SemSegNet
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.run_semsegnet_cli: run the SemSegNet module via CLI with argparse to create a model with custom hidden and embedding dimensions
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.create_semsegwrapper: create a SemSegWrapper to load a trained model and segment voxel blocks into semantic object classes
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.test_segment_object: test the SemSegWrapper segment_object method to classify 3D voxel blocks and return labeled locations
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.review_semsegnet_forward: review the SemSegNet forward pass that embeds block IDs and runs them through stacked 3D conv layers

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.train_semantic_segmentation_model: run the semantic segmentation training loop with configurable epochs, batch size, and learning rate via CLI args
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.validate_semseg_model: validate a semantic segmentation model on a DataLoader and return per-batch losses and accuracies
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.get_loss: compute masked NLL loss for semantic segmentation predictions sampling empty voxels with configurable probability
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.get_accuracy: calculate classification accuracy by comparing predicted class indices against ground truth labels
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.train_epoch: train one epoch of a semantic segmentation model returning per-batch losses and accuracies
